name: cozyting-promo
description: CozyTing multilingual promo film (zh-CN / en / ja, no narration) built with Remotion

scripts.render:zh: remotion render src/index.tsx CozyTingPromo out/cozyting-promo-zh.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:en: remotion render src/index.tsx CozyTingPromoEn out/cozyting-promo-en.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:ja: remotion render src/index.tsx CozyTingPromoJa out/cozyting-promo-ja.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:all: npm run render:zh && npm run render:en && npm run render:ja
